title: Does the heavy part of the sixteen jumping growths continue?
claim: After separating the two births of each recurring one-parent end, do the remaining birth counts on starts 03 and 14 stay bounded or grow without bound, and which group-only rosters close? What was the canonical source population?
standard_statement: Iterate a deterministic edge-clique cover operator on a finite incidence relation. Its next graph is the intersection graph of unheld maximal cliques, uncovered edges and funded singleton children. Remove the terminal singleton and its compulsory adjacent child from the sequence. Derive the boundary of the induced operator, a recurrence or divergence/closure obstruction, and test the actual finite input graphs and registered source frames.
prior_work: GROWTH-CONTINUES proves a recurring unary end, a complete-end closure test, trivial filled fundamental groups on all sixteen and a huge later group on 03. HUB-GUIDED-SAMPLE gives exact next counts/restrictions. PARTNER-RETRACT refutes weak retraction. REDUCE-BLOCKS gives the exact law; WALL-READ gives the partnered runaway; MERGE-BURST gives single-block finite tails; CHAIN-IDENT/RELAY-IDENT/DEAD-CAP classify restricted arrangements. The partner-screen excludes complete partnered forms in the finite archive. None of those widths establishes the fate of the unrestricted remaining groups on 03/14. Historical archive classifications used capped and jump-selected starts. The bounded-width recurrence argument has its classical analogue in clique dynamics (Larrión and Pizaña on expansive graphs); here the stage includes held blocks, capacities, and residual pairs.
source_contribution: Exact deleted and retained parent sets, individual loose supplies, held blocks on the remaining vertices, boundary descendants, exact repeated decorated rosters, finite-size parent-intersection obstructions, and row-by-row source and frequency denominators. Classify width only by all-depth proof.
remaining_obligations: A proof for each claimed fate, or an explicit unresolved recursion or obstruction after the boundary, positive examples, negative controls, all twelve tests and source recalculation have been performed. A finite sample or a missing enumeration is never an all-round verdict.
completion_gate: Prove each scoped assertion and report unrestricted status.
